task: In a fictional workshop, test compatibility on humanitarian needs assessment recommendations. You cannot adopt either historical draft or speak for the Council President.

glossary.focused: Needs findings remain confidential in both cycles.
glossary.staged: First-cycle findings stay confidential, with aggregate results guaranteed to be public in the second cycle.
glossary.broad: Aggregate findings are public in the first cycle.
glossary.joint: The United Nations and host government jointly coordinate the assessment.

cards.us: Accept a workshop recommendation only if a UN-led or jointly coordinated assessment makes aggregate findings public by the second cycle. First-cycle publication is also acceptable. An explicit consent clause is optional.
cards.ru-overlap: Accept a workshop recommendation only if the assessment requires explicit host consent and either the host leads or coordination is joint. First-cycle findings must stay confidential. A public aggregate report in the second cycle is acceptable.
cards.ru-impasse: Accept a workshop recommendation only if the assessment requires explicit host consent and either the host leads or coordination is joint. Findings must stay confidential in both cycles. A public aggregate report in either cycle is unacceptable.
